newsitem.title: USA: Fla. switched-at-birth teen is pregnant.
newsitem.headline: Fla. switched-at-birth teen is pregnant.

text.p: Kimberly Mays-Weeks, who was switched at birth and as a teenager waged a court battle to divorce her natural parents, will not take any chances with her own child, expected in September.
"The baby will be on my chest at all times," she said during an appearance on the syndicated "Rolanda" talk show set to air Friday.
The show's producers said Thursday that Mays-Weeks, 18, revealed on the programme that she was three months pregnant. She married Jeremy Weeks, 19, in Orlando near Walt Disney World last month.
Mays-Weeks was switched with another newborn at a Florida hospital when they were born in 1978, just hours apart.

At age 10, she learned the parents she had known all her life were not her natural parents. Then, at 14, she successfully sued to divorce her natural parents, who sought visitation rights to her. Later, she lived with them for a time.
